headline: Indian IT services posted mixed revenue growth with standout performance from Coforge and modest gains for the majors.
summary: Revenue grew across the sector, led by Coforge's 53.6% YoY surge. Most large players posted double‑digit growth, but Infosys trimmed its FY27 guidance to 1‑2% and saw only 1.5% revenue rise. AI‑related deals boosted profit margins for HCLTech and Mphasis, while Wipro's profit slipped despite revenue growth. Operating margins remained stable for most firms, with OFSS showing an unusually high 47.8% margin.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI revenue jumps, driving profit expansion and larger deal wins.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance, while HCLTech introduced a modest 2.5‑4% range.

themes.title: Margin resilience
themes.detail: Operating margins stayed healthy, with OFSS at 47.8% and TCS at 24%, despite varied growth rates.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance to 16%.
Strong AI‑led deals lifted profit 19.6% YoY and raised guidance outlook.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut to 1‑2%.
Profit fell 1.9% YoY despite revenue growth, and headcount declined.
